title: SegmentBox
description: One segment of a series' tree, as a partner receives it: its place in the tree and its four vertices (open, high, low, close, each with its time). Draw it as a box from open_time to close_time between low and high, with its line from open through high and low (in time order) to close. Nothing else of the tree leaves Patternode.

id.description: h<height>@<open_time>. The same segment has the same id in a segmentation and in every stream event that names it.

parent.description: The id of the segment one level up that contains this one; null at the top.

height.description: The level: 1 is the finest segments above the bars, larger is coarser.

order.description: Position among its siblings, in time order.

provisional.description: True for the open right edge: it may still extend, and its close may move. Every other segment is final.
